title: EU Council approves the 50 billion euro Ukraine Facility
body:
On 28 February 2024 the Council of the European Union approved the launch of the Ukraine Facility, a financial instrument worth 50 billion euros for the period 2024 to 2027. Ukraine's Ministry of Finance announced the decision, and Ukrinform reported it on 29 February 2024.

The European Parliament had backed the decision on 26 February 2024, and the Council's approval was the final step before the Facility could start operating. According to the Ministry of Finance, Ukraine was expected to receive around 39 billion euros in direct budget support over the four years, of which more than 5 billion euros would be grants.

The Ministry described the Facility as a way to support Ukraine's economic development and recovery on its path toward EU membership, based on plans agreed jointly with the European Commission. It also referred to a bridge financing mechanism that, once the necessary international agreements were signed, would allow money to flow faster before the Facility formally began. The Loan Agreement and Memorandum were expected to be signed in early March 2024.
